FROM FIRST WORDS ONWARD

The school for your busy toddler.

Toddler classes on Kiddo.school keep the same calm rhythm your baby knows — one card, one voice, one short moment — while your toddler’s world gets bigger: pointing, copying and naming everything they see.

Welcome to the toddler years. Kiddo.school classes keep the same calm rhythm — one card, one voice, one short moment — while your toddler’s world gets bigger: pointing, copying, first words and a name for everything they see. Every class shows the exact age, the class name and the subject it supports, and every class is led by you.

Toddler 1 · 12–18 months

Lesson 7Talk & Think

First Words: Food & Home

Everyday foods and home things — apple, cup, spoon, bed — name them, pause, and let the first words grow. Three to five playful minutes.

Start today’s class ↗

Toddler 2 · 18–24 months

Lesson 8Think & Talk

First Concepts

Big and small, up and down, full and empty — six concept pairs in realistic pictures, ready for a short game of say it and look. Three to five playful minutes.

Start today’s class ↗

Toddler 3 · Age 2

Lesson 9Think & Talk

Colors and Shapes

Eight colors, seven shapes, big-button find-it games and real-world hunts — a first interactive class made for two-year-old hands. Three to five playful minutes.

Start today’s class ↗

Toddler 4 · Age 2

Lesson 10Think & Talk

Matching and Sorting

Same and different, big-button find-the-match games, gentle sorting and an odd-one-out finish — noticing relationships, made for two-year-old hands. Three to five playful minutes.

Start today’s class ↗

Toddler 5 · Age 2

Lesson 11Talk & Explore

Animals and Sounds

Twenty animals with big sounds and two tap games — meet the farm, roar with the wild ones, then listen for animals outside. Made for two-year-old hands.

Start today’s class ↗

Toddler 6 · Age 2

Lesson 12Talk & Explore

Vehicles and Sounds

Beep beep! Twenty vehicles with big sounds and three quick games — cars, trains, boats and one loud rocket.

Start today’s class ↗

Toddler 7 · Age 2

Lesson 13Talk & Connect

Emotions & Feelings

Twenty feelings with friendly faces and two quick games — name them together, make the faces, then spot those feelings in your own day. Made for two-year-olds.

Start today’s class ↗

Toddler 8 · Age 2

Lesson 14Nature & Talk

Garden Bugs & Friends

Twenty little garden friends — a bee, a butterfly, a snail and more — with two gentle games and a garden hunt for after class. Made for two-year-olds.

Start today’s class ↗

Circle Time · Age 2

Circle Time 1Age 2

Hello School! Circle Time

A short preschool-style circle time: hello rhythm, copy-me movement, listening games, faces, a tiny story and goodbye — then off the rug together.
